summary: Ferroglobe PLC furnished a Form 6-K (foreign-private-issuer current report) containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and call presentation. Alongside results — sales of $369.8M, adjusted EBITDA of negative $2.4M on elevated energy costs — the company announced a footprint rationalization: plans to close five plants, shift output to lower-cost facilities, raise utilization toward roughly 80%, and cut overhead 20%, targeting $85-115M adjusted EBITDA improvement at full run rate. Plant closures remain subject to employee information and consultation processes; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch execution and consultation risk against the $100M +/-15% target.
